architectural_costs: Call leaf C worker uses a compiler-owned physical activation192B;no JS frame/argument copy. No ARM speed parity claim.
Core/frame/state layouts retained; bounded bytecode hints and strong character atom cache retain original real memory costs.
Nested GC inside a public custom free/finalizer reproduces the inherited abort;GC after ordinary return and supported JS reentry remain tested.

Array/TypedArray and five JSON callback selectors retain prepared-capsule preference for short callbacks. They intentionally omit the x86 noncalling ChildLeaf competing-provider exclusions. The ARM leaf worker has a real192B C activation;these routing preferences are functionally tested and require hardware profiling before any speed-parity claim. The old generator comment describing that x86 provider as open is historical;the actual ARM aggregate leaf route is implemented.
reviewed_boundaries: MSVC-only coroutine native segments/extra method learning
Ordinary async output-capability elision, absent in accepted GNU reference
completion_rule: Product ACCEPTANCE.json binds the delivered source and SDK identities;QEMU functionality does not qualify real ARM speed/RSS/PMU
